# 26.2 Step Mini Marathon

> A 501(c)(3) nonprofit (in formation) in Omaha, Nebraska that raises awareness of hereditary
> cancer risk, removes barriers to education and genetic testing, and helps families take
> informed action. Founded in 2016 by Denise Ibsen Cole. The event is "26.2 steps, not miles" —
> a marathon anyone can complete, regardless of ability.

## Key facts
- Founder: Denise Ibsen Cole, MPA (BRCA1 carrier and patient advocate)
- Origin: In 2016, after breaking her hip training for the Chicago Marathon, Denise created a
  "mini marathon" of 26.2 steps so everyone could cross a finish line.
- Mission framework: Awareness, Empowerment, Action.
- Cause: hereditary cancer risk broadly (breast, ovarian, colon/Lynch, pancreatic, prostate,
  skin, bladder) — not any single cancer.
- EIN: 42-3384604 (501(c)(3) in formation)

## Events
- Cancer Survivorship Conference Mini Marathon — Sept 4, 2026, UNO Scott Center, Omaha.
- 10-Year 26.2 Step Mini Marathon — Sept 20, 2026, Cancer Survivors Park, Omaha.
- North Omaha 26.2 Step Mini Marathon — June 25, 2027, The Venue at Highlander Accelerator.
- Registration is free and open to all abilities.
